_why: The downmix badge is the only COMPOSED label on this page and it renders ONLY when getDownmixStatus() reports an active fold-down. The generic stub's default for that name is the STRING '{}', on which `status.active` is undefined, so the badge stays hidden and ui.downmix would be a key the geometry gate never measures. This supplies the shape PluginEditor.cpp really completes with (an object carrying active/sourceChannels/targetChannels), so the badge renders and both languages are measured. TEST FIXTURE ONLY - never shipped, never embedded. v1.4.0 adds getPresetListGrouped and getCurrentPreset: the generic stub returns an empty menu, so the category headers and the .active item - two of the page's walnut-on-paper text surfaces - were never rendered and never measured by measure-ui --contrast. The shape is the ARRAY of {category, presets} PluginEditor.cpp completes with.
